billing-engine.description: Subscription lifecycle engine — state machine, proration math, cancellation, and applyDueTransitions. Use when working on lib/subscription/, lib/proration/, or the subscription model/transitions.

payment-integration.description: Flutterwave integration — webhook handling, signature verification, idempotency, server-side transaction verification, checkout initiation, and rate limiting. Use when working on lib/payment/, app/api/webhooks/, app/api/checkout/, app/api/verify/, or lib/rate-limit.ts.

billing-ui-ux.description: Billing UI/UX — pages, components, design language, status badges, error/empty states, dark mode, accessibility. Use when working on app/billing/, app/plans/, app/checkout/success/, components/, or app/globals.css.
